notes.title: GGnZ Update v3.0 - Raging Steel
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are very excited to announce that "Raging Steel" major update is now available!

With this update we are introducing a brand new game mode! Players can now take their own car to the streets and race against the opponents on three new locations! To start a race, simply travel to the new "Garage" location from the tactical map menu.

The garage is where players can select a race and upgrade their car to increase its performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/2cab5f08ec5675fd41ff6101fa68946ddc9ee6f1.png[/img]

The upgrades in the garage work the same way as deployment boosts, and while players keep racing these upgrades will persist between racing sessions. However, if players will leave the garage, these upgrades will be reset.

We are introducing three different racing tracks with this update. Each track has a different setting and will require different approach to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/5757b8de42a3136d6039e6cfa6d410b55959b943.png[/img]

Players will be able to configure the numbers of laps and a number of opponents before each race.

We have also added new Steam achievements that players can now unlock with this new game mode!

Please refer to the update notes for a full list of features.

Update Notes

Added:

* New location on tactical map
* New Racing game mode
* New Garage
* New Steam Achievements now available with Racing mode

We are looking forward to your feedback!

Thank you.

notes.title: GGnZ Update v2.0 - The Gauntlet
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are very excited to announce that "The Gauntlet" major update is now available!

With this update we are introducing a brand new "Checkpoint" location on a tactical map with a new Gauntlet game mode where players will face endless hordes of enemies with overwhelming odds. Each wave cleared will yield a large amount of resources that can be used or traded in the camp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/16b88e5df67b186706e1e26185d2be3bd3fed00a.png[/img]

Additionally, we are introducing a new mechanic on the gauntlet location where players will use the environment to gain the advantage on the horde. New climbing / vaulting mechanic allows players to quickly vault over designated obstacles and use other means of tactical escape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/db671c89ca7955cd5e63f91ce5d1a0a5838202f7.png[/img]

These tactical routes have cooldowns that will reset with enemy waves cleared. Different routes have different cooldown times. Look for new blue painted barricades scattered around the location and open containers.

We have also put a lot of work into updating all of the systems to support the new functionality.

Please refer to the update notes for a full list of features.

Update Notes

Added:

* New location on tactical map
* New Gauntlet game mode
* New Climb / Vault system
* New Escape routes mechanics
* New Steam Achievements now available for Gauntlet mode


Adjustments:

* Updated trading system per community requests
* Enemy spawn system updated to support new game mode
* Enemy AI systems updated to support new game mode
* Player controller has been updated to support new functionality
* Updated enemy navigation system to support new functionality
* Reworked gunplay mechanics, loaded ammo is now properly processed


Fixes:

* Fixed aim braking when camera is clipping at close range
* Fixed an issue where sometimes firing was allowed during sprinting
* Multiple graphic fixes to game interfaces


What is coming next!
We will now focus our development efforts on a brand new game mode that will add something completely new to the mix. Please stay tuned for more details as we will be sharing them later in the week.

We are looking forward to your feedback!

Thank you.

notes.title: GGnZ Update v1.9 - Hold Fast
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are very excited to announce that "Hold Fast" major update is here!

With this update we are introducing a brand new location on a tactical map with a new Defense game mode where players are presented with a choice of point of interest to defend against waves of enemies. Each point of interest will yield different resources as a reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/24830a6e46690a840e9fc055bc9df31e158198ef.png[/img]

The new Fuel resource is now fully operational with this update. Players will be able to extract fuel from the Gas Station Defense round, or trade it in the Camp, at the Quartermaster.

A lot of work has been put into updating all of the systems to support the new functionality.

Please refer to the update notes for a full list of features.

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[h2]Added:[/h2]

* New location on tactical map

* New Defense game mode

* New resource type "Fuel"

* New fuel trade mechanic


[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]

* Enemy spawn system updated to support new game mode

* Enemy AI systems updated to support new game mode

* Updated death screen with new functions and description

* Multiple updates to player interface to support new functionality


[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

* Fixed navigation for AI to increase performance
* Multiple graphic fixes to game interfaces


[h3]What is coming next![/h3]
We will now focus our development efforts on additional new locations and game modes! Please stay tuned for more details as we will be sharing them later in the week.

We are looking forward to your feedback!

Thank you.

notes.title: GGnZ Update v1.8 - Weapons of Choice!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are very excited to announce that another major update "Weapons of Choice" is here!

With this update we are introducing a brand new Armory feature that will allow players to unlock many different weapons to use on scavenging run. A new resource type is also available for trade and scavenging. Additionally we are rolling out several fixes to issues that were discovered by our team.

A lot of work has been put into this update. We have completely redesigned the gunplay mechanic to allow for the new system integration into the gameplay.

Please refer to the update notes for a full list of features.

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[h2]Added:[/h2]

* New Armory
Players will now be able to access the Armory from the deployment screen.

* New resource type "Parts"
Look for the blue smoke as you are scavenging the city. New "Parts" resource type can be collected or traded at the quartermaster. It is used to unlock new weapons in the Armory.

* New weapon stats system
With this new system in place, each weapon now has different stats. Try them all out and see what works best for your play style!

* Lots of new gun sounds!
The new and old guns go pew pew!

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]

* Resource spawn system adjusted
The resource spawn system has been updated to support new functionalities.

* Player controller revised
The player controller has been revised to support the new systems introduced with this update.

* Enemy AI revised
The enemy AI has been updated to support the new systems.

Fixes:

* Fixed colliders on the city map in several places
* Fixed the issue with several resource spawn points where resources still would not respawn
* Multiple graphic fixes and updates to game interfaces


[h3]What is coming next![/h3]
We will now focus our development efforts on the new locations and game modes! We are planning to introduce a new location to travel on the tactical map that will feature a brand new game mode. Please stay tuned for more details as we will be sharing them later this week.

We will also be working on new media materials to update the Steam store page with new content that has been implemented into the game over the last few updates. If you enjoy our game please tell a friend!

We are looking forward to your feedback!

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Update II
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!

We just wanted to share a little information about our next major update called "Weapons of Choice" that we are currently working on.

In this upcoming update, we will be introducing a new weapon system into the gameplay. Players will be able to unlock a verity of weapons that will have different stats. To support this new system we are also introducing new resource type, that players will be able to collect from scavenging runs or trade at quartermaster in the camp.

[h3]We have a lot of weapons for you to choose from[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40143385/1900ee12fb987d6fb7775d942a5fedfa8c08c8c3.png[/img]

Assault rifles, SMGs, shotguns and sidearms will become available for production at the quartermaster.

We also have plans for new locations that will be coming after this update, but these are still in early phases of design and we will be sharing more information down the road.

Thank you.

notes.title: GGnZ Update v1.6.0.00 with new "Death from Above" feature
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

GGnZ update v1.6.0.00 is now live. Please see the patch notes below for details.

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

* Revised resource spawn system
Resource spawn system has been adjusted, this should resolve the issue with lack of resources spawns.

[h3]Added:[/h3]

Enable this options if you are experiencing the screen tearing issue.

[h2]New Feature[/h2]

Introducing the new "Death from Above" feature! Players can now purchase a brand new deployment upgrade that will unlock Mortar Support! Yes, that's right! With Mortar Support upgrade, players will be able to throw smoke grenade by pressing "B" to signal the mortar bombardment! Mortar shells will come down raining havoc on the horde, with high damage explosive rounds. 

We hope you enjoy this new feature and your feedback is very welcomed!


Thank you.

notes.title: GGnZ Update v1.5 - The Ravenous Horde!
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are very excited to announce that our second major update "The Ravenous Horde" is here!

With this update we are introducing a verity of new enemy types and many new gameplay mechanics. Additionally we are rolling out several fixes to issues that were discovered by our team.

Please refer to the update notes for a full list of features.

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[h2]Added:[/h2]

* New female zombies are joining the horde
We are expanding the horde with over 15 new female zombies.

* New enemy type, Crawler is joining the horde
Watch out for the new crawler zombies sneaking up on you and biting your ankles!

* New enemy type, Hunter is joining the horde
Listen for Hunters, a new aggressive zombies that will charge you head on and deliver higher damage. Take them down before they reach you.

* New enemy type, Siren is joining the horde
Watch and listen for a new Siren zombie, she will screech and alert all the enemies in the vicinity if she spots you!

* New enemy type, Bloater is joining the horde
These nasty zombies can be spotted by the green aura of filth around them. Do not let them get close as they will explode in a cloud of gas and filth damaging everything around them!

* New Ravenous Horde mechanic
We are introducing a new threat mechanic into the game! The longer you stay on the map and shoot zombies, the higher the threat level will grow. As the threat level grows, zombies become stronger and more special types of zombies will be spawning around the map.

* New Grenades mechanic
You got new toys in the armory! Players will now be able to carry up to 5 grenades, that will deal heavy area damage when explode. Press "G" to throw a grenade. Ammo pickups now have a chance to grant grenades.

* New "Frag Grenade" Perk!
This new perk greatly increases the effectiveness of grenades.

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]

* Armored zombies revised
The armored zombies are not as easy to kill! Their armor protects them from your bullets, so aim well and shoot them where they have no armor.

Fixes:

* Fixed the issue with all weapons ray-cast system failing after missing
* Fixed the issue with ammo not being properly calculated sometimes

[h3]What is coming next![/h3]
We will now focus on the new "Weapons of Choice" update development. This update will allow players to choose different weapons for all categories, Primary, Secondary and sidearm. Each weapon will have different stats. Players will have to craft new weapons with a new crafting mechanic that will be available at the Quartermaster in the camp.

We are looking forward to your feedback!

Thank you.

notes.title: GGnZ Update v1.3 - Perks and Quartermaster
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are excited to announce that our first major update v1.3 is here!

With this update we are introducing the new Perks system that players can unlock in the camp. These Perks will grant permanent bonuses to all characters. 

Additionally, the Quartermaster deployment upgrades are now available to players, after unlocking the Quartermaster in the camp. Quartermaster boosts will be available in a new pre-deployment stage and will provide temporary bonuses for the duration of the deployment. 

The new pre-deployment stage is a groundwork for the new features that we will be adding in future updates. Players will be able to select different sections of the city to travel to and trade resources for fuel at Quartermaster.

Please refer to the update notes for the full list of features.

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[h2]Added:[/h2]

* New Perks unlocks
* New Quartermaster system
* New Pre-Deployment stage
* Expanded control options with mouse invert and sensitivity
* Added direct gun select with 1,2,3

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]

* Zombie animations adjusted
* Zombie AI adjusted to support new game mechanics
* Gunplay mechanics updated to support new functionality
* Player controller updated to support new functionality
* Items / inventory logic updated to support new functionality
* Multiple graphical assets added / replaced

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

* Fixed zombie AI player detection issue
* Fixed issue where resources would not spawn sometimes
* Fixed the issue with enemy death physics not applying sometimes

[h3]More good news![/h3]
We have already begun our work on the "Ravenous Horde" update! The next update we will be rolling out to further expand the gameplay. With this update we will be introducing a verity of new enemies, as well new enemy types.

Stay tuned for more announcements with details about our upcoming updates.

Thank you.

notes.title: GGnZ Post Release - Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

We are very excited to announce that we now have a development roadmap for GGnZ's post release features that will be implemented into the game throughout several patches and major updates.

We plan to expand the gameplay elements by introducing new features and improving features that are currently available in game for players.

[h1]Planned changes[/h1]

[h2]New types of enemies will be joining the horde![/h2]
Players will face new enemies roaming the streets of the city, that will require more tactical approach to defeat.

[h2]New Perks mechanic![/h2]
Players will be able to spend resources on new perks that will improve the performance of all characters. Perks such as increased accuracy, increased health and other enhanced properties that will allow players to face stronger enemies, and increase the chances of survival.

[h2]New Quartermaster deployment boosts![/h2]
Players will be able to unlock a Quartermaster in their camp to gain access to additional enhancements during the scavenging runs, such as extra ammo reserves and decreased aggro, etc..

[h2]New Tactical Map![/h2]
Players will be able to travel to different sections of the city and fight the horde on different maps. Some maps will offer unique enemies to hunt. Traveling across the city will require a new Fuel resource that will become available for scavenging or processing resources at Quartermaster in the camp.

[h2]New Girls![/h2]
New girls will be joining the team! We plan to add new characters to the team, to make it even more fun.

[h2]New Weapons Mechanics![/h2]
We will be working on developing and enhancing the gunplay mechanic system to allow players to choose from different weapons that can be researched with the new Quartermaster system.

[h2]Expanding the Options![/h2]
We plan to expand the options based on the feedback that we received from the community. Options like Mouse sensitivity and look invert, etc..

We plan to rollout these features gradually over the course of several updates that we will be scheduling and announcing to the community.

Our preliminary estimate is to have all of the features mentioned above, released by Q4 of 2021.

[h3]And more good news![/h3]
We will be rolling out the first update as early as this week! This update will feature some of the elements mentioned above and will also serve as ground work for the rest of the features that will be rolled out in the updates after that. Players will already see the base we are building for all the changes to come.

Please feel welcomed to join the discussion on the games community HUB! Your feedback will help us make the game better!

Thank you!

notes.title: GGnZ - Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

We are excited to announce that our first update for GGnZ is here!

In this update we are addressing a few fixes that were discovered by our team, but mostly focusing on the gameplay mechanics updates based on the feedback provided by the players.

[b]Update Notes[/b]

Fixes:

* Fixed an issue where music would not play sometimes when starting the game
* Fixed enemy path finding routine mechanics

Updates:

* Implemented new dynamic accuracy system

The gunplay accuracy has been improved for primary and sidearm weapons with our new dynamic accuracy system. The accuracy offset will now drift based on the bursts fired. Single shots and short bursts will now be more effective at longer ranges.

* Shotgun effectiveness improved

Shotgun damage and accuracy has been slightly increased, making it more effective against enemies up close and medium range.

* Zombies Mechanics Improved

Enemies will now become more threatening! Zombies will run more often, and will pursue players more effectively. Zombies now have a chance of dealing more damage to the player.

We are currently working on a plan to implement additional game mechanics that will further boost the gameplay experience, as well as add new features to the game. These features will include, more maps, more enemy types, new characters will be joining, new perks system, deployment upgrades and more!

Please stay tuned for a detailed short and long terms development plan that we are going to post later this week.

Thank you!
